mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REVIEW_REPORT SET STATUS_CD = CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' THEN #{pendingStatus} ELSE STATUS_CD END, ADMIN_NO = CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' THEN #{adminNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ELSE ADMIN_NO END, PROCESS_DATE = CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' THEN SYSDATE ELSE PROCESS_DATE END, REVIEW_ID = NULL WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
UPDATE TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = #{newStatus}, ADMIN_NO = #{adminNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
